integration_architecture.pipeline: Input URL -> Passive URL ML v2.0.0 Feature Extraction & Inference -> SSRF Pre-validation -> Safe Multi-hop Website Fetch -> Deterministic HTML Security Inspection -> Unified Risk Engine Evidence Aggregation -> Multi-modal Final Risk Assessment

evidence_aggregation_rules.has_critical_website_evidence: Elevates overall risk to CRITICAL and decreases uncertainty (uncertainty: LOW)
evidence_aggregation_rules.url_clean_but_page_malicious: Risk is elevated by deterministic website evidence (defeats cloaked/clean-looking phishing URLs)
evidence_aggregation_rules.url_suspicious_but_page_unreachable: URL ML evidence is retained, uncertainty is elevated, explanation clearly documents fetch failure without clearing risk
